title: Kissed Crispy Moroccan Lamb Kefta Tagine
description: A light and crispy Moroccan dish featuring lamb kefta, flavored with resinous spices and grilled to perfection, served in a tagine with a dairy-free friendly sauce, and including unflavored gelatin for texture.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, making sure the grates are clean and brush them with oil to prevent sticking.

In a large bowl, combine the lamb mince, unflavored gelatin, olive oil, onion, garlic, ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and mix everything together with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate the mixture for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld and the gelatin to soften.
When ready to cook, thread the lamb mixture onto skewers, if using, and brush the grill grates with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kefta for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
While the kefta are cooking, prepare the tagine sauce by combining the olive oil, garlic, and spices in a small bowl.
Once the kefta are done, remove them from the grill and place them in the tagine, spooning some of the sauce over the top of each kefta.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately over couscous or rice.
Traditionally, the tagine is cooked in a clay pot with a conical lid, but a large skillet or Dutch oven can be used as a substitute.
